'''Borderpost Parthos''' was a military outpost of [[House of Thul|House Thul]] that was situated on the edge of [[Pestilence Pond]] in the [[Kaamos Territory]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].
